Streptomycin + Tetracycline for agriculture: draft order S.O. 5295(E) of 17.12.2021 (Prohibition of Streptomycin + Tetracycline in agriculture Order, 2021) proposes no import, manufacture or formulation for agricultural use from 01.02.2022 and a complete ban on use in agriculture from 01.01.2024. We found no final notification, and the DPPQS consolidated list of 31.10.2026 does not list it; Pairu treats it as banned as a precaution, because the Registration Committee approved the phase-out in August 2021.
